## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: In eliminate mode the dispatcher refuses a reviewer whose vendor/model...

The system SHALL ensure that in eliminate mode the dispatcher refuses a reviewer whose vendor/model matches the author's unless an operator override is supplied, and the override is recorded in the audit trail.

#### Scenario: In eliminate mode the dispatcher refuses a reviewer whose vendor/model...

WHEN `add-eliminative-adversarial-review-mode` is implemented
THEN In eliminate mode the dispatcher refuses a reviewer whose vendor/model matches the author's unless an operator override is supplied, and the override is recorded in the audit trail.

### Requirement: A seeded ledger with an uncited claim and a contradicting fact yields...

The system SHALL ensure that a seeded ledger with an uncited claim and a contradicting fact yields findings of type uncited_claim and contradicting_fact that validate against review-findings.schema.json.

#### Scenario: A seeded ledger with an uncited claim and a contradicting fact yields...

WHEN `add-eliminative-adversarial-review-mode` is implemented
THEN A seeded ledger with an uncited claim and a contradicting fact yields findings of type uncited_claim and contradicting_fact that validate against review-findings.schema.json.

### Requirement: The reviewer prompt contains the ledger and excludes the author's reasoning...

The system SHALL ensure that the reviewer prompt contains the ledger and excludes the author's reasoning transcript.

#### Scenario: The reviewer prompt contains the ledger and excludes the author's reasoning...

WHEN `add-eliminative-adversarial-review-mode` is implemented
THEN The reviewer prompt contains the ledger and excludes the author's reasoning transcript.
